scope.actions: Read project source, SDK headers and exact-version official Chromium/CEF source. Downloaded official source into /private/tmp/acanvas-native-scroll-source-20261009. Wrote this research evidence only.

conclusion: Chromium has a real internal rendering-pause primitive that preserves Page visibility. CEF154 and its registered public DevTools/SDK methods do not expose an atomic pause-completion plus all-scroll-main-ack plus exact-surface-readback transaction.

The public callbacks/protocol fields inspected do not expose same-frame transforms and rectangles for every semantic element, including nested scroll, fixed and sticky cases. Root viewport scroll metadata is a narrower capability.

A timestamp-capable CEF external-begin-frame extension is feasible using an existing consumer, but timestamp and BeginFrameAck alone do not solve F2. A complete generic transaction requires renderer/cc integration and rebuilding the CEF framework from its Chromium source dependency tree.

capabilities.capability: Hard pause of renderer main and compositor impl rendering, after in-flight work drains.
capabilities.consumer: WebFrameWidgetImpl::PauseRendering -> LayerTreeHost::PauseRendering / ScopedPauseRendering -> ProxyMain::SetPauseRendering -> ProxyImpl::SetPauseRendering -> Scheduler::SetPauseRendering -> SchedulerStateMachine::BeginFrameNeeded.
capabilities.behavior: The scoped object posts pause to the impl thread. Scheduler drains an in-flight main frame, pending tree and first draw of an activated tree, then stops impl frames. The code path does not call Page/WebContents visibility methods. Destruction requests a commit and resumes rendering.
capabilities.limits: The returned scoped object has no drain-completed callback and does not flush all final impl scroll deltas back into Blink. It does not identify a captured root Surface. Exposing this one method is insufficient for the current pairing contract.

capabilities.capability: Compositor-to-main scroll synchronization covers scroll nodes by ElementId, including nested scrollers.
capabilities.consumer: ProxyImpl::ScheduledActionSendBeginMainFrame -> LayerTreeHostImpl::ProcessCompositorDeltas -> InputHandler::ProcessCommitDeltas -> ScrollTree::CollectScrollDeltas -> ProxyMain::BeginMainFrame -> LayerTreeHost::ApplyCompositorChanges -> UpdateScrollOffsetFromImpl/client viewport changes.
capabilities.behavior: Normal BeginMainFrame transfers a delta vector for each changed scroller and viewport/page-scale data before main frame lifecycle. This is the real engine synchronization path, rather than screenshot-side numeric correction.
capabilities.limits: The impl can continue animating after those deltas are collected. A normal BeginMainFrame/commit ack therefore does not identify the scroll state used by a later screenshot. Calling an unmodified normal BMF after rendering pause also conflicts with its BMF suppression.

capabilities.reason: PageHandler first calls WebContents::WasHidden, then SetPageFrozen. It changes source visibility and page lifecycle, so this public entry cannot satisfy the unchanged-source requirement.

OnRenderFrameMetadataChangedAfterActivation reads latest root_scroll_offset, updates last_scroll_offset_ and posts one asynchronous UI task; OnScrollOffsetChanged later emits the latest stored value. It is not bound to the OnPaint bitmap. OnPaint has pixel dimensions/dirty rectangles only. OnAcceleratedPaint.extra has capture timestamp/counter, dimensions and update/region rectangles, with no nested-scroll or per-element geometry.

InspectorLayerTreeAgent traverses RootCcLayer and main-thread cc::Layer objects, computes ScreenSpaceTransform there, and optionally associates a layer with an owner DOM node. It neither exports every semantic element nor provides a capture frame token. Its sticky consumer explicitly misses some multiple-transform-node cases. DOMSnapshot first updates the main lifecycle to CompositingInputsClean, then walks DOM/layout trees; it does not read a selected compositor capture frame or flush its final impl deltas.

PageHandler::OnFrameFromVideoConsumer extracts root_scroll_offset and scale from the same media::VideoFrame used to obtain its bitmap. The public payload has root viewport fields only. A wrapper root viewport is distinct from descendant source scrolling; even a source-root capture lacks the complete ancestor transform/clip/scroll chain of every fixed/sticky/nested element. The downstream Viz provenance investigation remains executor-owned.

capabilities.capability: Copy an existing compositor Surface without asking Page.captureScreenshot to force its own redraw.
capabilities.limits: The method is internal CEF/content code. Existing Page.captureScreenshot instead finishes through RenderWidgetHostImpl::GetSnapshotFromBrowser. A custom transaction must retain/select the exact root Surface and its child frames; pause plus the existing screenshot path is not a proven substitute.

patchCandidates.proposal: Expose external BeginFrame(frameTimeTicks, interval, completion) through CEF BrowserHost, OSR delegate and OSR view.
patchCandidates.existingConsumer: CefRenderWidgetHostViewOSR::SendExternalBeginFrame constructs viz::BeginFrameArgs with TimeTicks::Now and calls ui::Compositor::IssueExternalBeginFrame. The downstream compositor API already accepts complete BeginFrameArgs and a BeginFrameAck callback. Current CEF OnFrameComplete only clears begin_frame_pending_.
patchCandidates.requiredDetails: Use one caller-specified T for the root and popup (current popup forwarding obtains another Now). Preserve real-time 60 Hz driver and current 30 Hz native paint configuration outside capture. Expose actual completion instead of silent return while begin_frame_pending_.
patchCandidates.limits: BeginFrameAck is not a Blink-all-scroll-ack or per-element semantic snapshot. Multiple frames at the same T still need a defined main/impl ordering. This is a building block, not a validated F2 fix.

patchCandidates.proposal: Add a renderer/cc capture transaction with an explicit drained/pinned frame boundary and final scroll/viewport synchronization.
requiredSequence: Enter the existing source task boundary and retain source state; coordinate every participating root/OOPIF/popup widget through the browser-side owner.

Request internal rendering pause and receive an impl-thread acknowledgement only after in-flight main updates, activation and first draw drain. Pin the actual active renderer frame/Surface selected at this boundary.

While impl animation/scroll advancement stays held, transfer all pending compositor scroll/page-scale deltas through the engine ApplyCompositorChanges path and obtain a main-thread acknowledgement. Do not project the root scroll delta onto arbitrary DOM rectangles.

Either extract geometry from the pinned committed main state plus its exact active property transforms, or permit one transaction-specific lifecycle/commit/draw at the retained T and pin that resulting frame. The latter needs an explicit single-step path because ordinary PauseRendering blocks BMF. Source-script callbacks remain deferred in the capture scope.

Read full semantic geometry and root pixels from that same pinned state/Surface, combine popup pixels from the corresponding held widget state, then release scopes and resume normal real-time frame scheduling.
necessaryPatchPoints: cc/trees/layer_tree_host.{h,cc} and proxy_main/proxy_impl for capture request, final delta-transfer handshake and acknowledgement
cc/scheduler/scheduler{,_state_machine}.{h,cc} for drain-completed acknowledgement and any explicitly permitted fixed-time capture step
Blink/CEF renderer-side endpoint that can reach the actual WebFrameWidgetImpl/LayerTreeHost; browser-side CEF owner and existing OSR CopyFromSurface bridge
patchCandidates.limits: This is a source-backed integration outline, not a compiled API or runtime result. Deadlock ordering with the current debugger nested loop, scroll-linked effects, media textures, cross-process Surface aggregation, cancellation and exact latency require implementation and isolated acceptance. An existing ScopedPauseRendering return cannot be used as the completion acknowledgement.

patchCandidates.proposal: Export same-frame per-element compositor geometry alongside pixels.
patchCandidates.reason: A full generic alternative requires committed DOM-to-property-tree mappings plus the chosen active scroll/transform/clip/effect state for every relevant element and root/OOPIF Surface projection. LayerTree owner-node metadata and root VideoFrame scroll fields do not supply that set. Adding only all scroll offsets remains insufficient for fixed/sticky and transformed ancestor geometry.
patchCandidates.limits: No registered CEF/CDP callback inspected exports this packet today. No minimal wrapper-only implementation was found; the exact serialization and Viz association design remains open.

buildScope.wrapperOnly: The current project CMake builds main.mm and libcef_dll_wrapper, then copies the prebuilt Chromium Embedded Framework.framework. It cannot modify renderer/cc/OSR internal consumers.
buildScope.timestampExtension: Can be implemented in CEF source using the existing ui::Compositor consumer, without changing Chromium behavior, but still requires a newly built CEF framework.
buildScope.completeTransaction: Requires CEF browser+renderer integration and engine/cc changes for atomic acknowledgement/single-step semantics. Build the macOS arm64 cef_framework target from a matching Chromium source/DEPS checkout. A first source build compiles its dependency graph; later builds can be incremental. Building every Chrome executable is unnecessary, but using only the downloaded binary SDK is insufficient.
buildScope.abi: A new public CEF method entails its standard generated C/C++ API bindings. An internal private message route can avoid public API addition but still requires replacing the built framework and cannot avoid renderer/cc work.
buildScope.cost: No build-duration, storage or runtime-performance estimate was measured. No build or binary swap was performed.

excluded: No flags were proposed as fixes; no visibility changes, instant scroll, source CSS injection, cancel/restart of scrolling, sleeps, retries, screenshot-derived semantic correction, pixel witnesses, new gate or runtime change was used.
